headline: Recommended giving site control of 142 South Bend Street to the Pawtucket School Committee for a new high school.
summary: A resolution would give the Pawtucket School Committee site control of 142 South Bend Street. The city bought the two parcels there for the new unified high school project. The vote to recommend approval was 3-0.
decisions: Recommended approval 3-0 of a resolution giving the Pawtucket School Committee site control of 142 South Bend Street for a new unified high school.

decision_titles: Site control of 142 South Bend Street for high school
plain_text:
PAWTUCKET CITY COUNCIL 
CITY PROPERTY COMMITTEE 
SEPTEMBER 10, 2026 
 
A meeting of the City Council City Property Committee was held on Thursday, September 10, 
2026, at 6:15 p.m., in the Temporary City Council Office, Room 204, 2nd floor, 100 Freight Street, 
Pawtucket, RI. 
 
Present – Councilor Stachowiak, Chair; Councilors Araujo and Moreno. 
 
Absent – 0. 
 
Councilor Stachowiak presided. 
 
Also present was Frank J. Milos, Jr., Esq., City Solicitor. 
 
The Committee conducted a public input period, at which there were no speakers. 
 
 
The Committee took up the following: 
 
RESOLUTION PROVIDING SITE CONTROL OF 142 SOUTH BEND STREET TO THE 
PAWTUCKET SCHOOL COMMITTEE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A NEW UNIFIED 
HIGH SCHOOL IN THE CITY OF PAWTUCKET 
 
Mr. Milos stated that the two parcels that make up 142 South Bend Street were purchased by the 
city to be used as part of the new unified high school project.  The city needs to turn site control of 
this property over to the school committee.  This resolution does that. 
 
Upon motion made by Councilor Araujo, seconded by Councilor Moreno, the Committee 
recommended APPROVAL of this resolution on a roll call vote, as follows: 
 
AYES – Councilor Stachowiak, Chair; Councilors Araujo and Moreno. 
 
NOES – 0. 
 
The meeting was adjourned at 6:19 p.m. 
 
 
 
Richard J. Goldstein, MMC, Clerk 
Pawtucket City Council
